findings.evidence: In frontend/index.html:5458-5508, saveScheduleAdjustments() computes a diff against originalScheduleSnapshot and omits unmodified entries from diffList—including an untouched blank-date UNFINISHED_SHIP row (as exercised in tests/frontend-isolated.js:311-386, where UNFIN-SHIP is kept untouched while NEW-SHIP is added and DEMO-W13 is deleted, producing a diffList of length 2 without UNFIN-SHIP). In gas/monitor.js:987, update_schedule unconditionally executes props.deleteProperty('UNFINISHED_SHIP') before calling updateFirebaseScheduleList(true) at line 991. In tests/test_gas_archive.js:760-811 (scenario 32), update_schedule is only tested when UNFIN_A itself is explicitly included in the payload (is_deleted: true), not when an unrelated ship is added, edited, or deleted while UNFINISHED_SHIP remains untouched.
findings.impact: When an UNFINISHED_SHIP (d: "") is pending in GAS ScriptProperties after a no_entry_reason stop and an operator opens 船期調整 to add, edit, or delete any other ship without modifying the unfinished ship, saving sends a diff that excludes UNFINISHED_SHIP, GAS unconditionally deletes UNFINISHED_SHIP without writing it to schedule_overrides, and updateFirebaseScheduleList(true) silently drops the pending ship from formal/schedule_list.
findings.recommendation: In gas/monitor.js (update_schedule, around line 987), delete UNFINISHED_SHIP only when the parsed UNFINISHED_SHIP ship_name (matched via sanitizeKey) appears in the incoming schedule diff list (either updated with a date/attributes or deleted via is_deleted: true), or when resetting via reset=true. Add a test scenario in tests/test_gas_archive.js verifying that updating/deleting another ship while UNFINISHED_SHIP is pending preserves UNFINISHED_SHIP at the top of schedule_list.
findings.resolution_condition: gas/monitor.js update_schedule preserves UNFINISHED_SHIP when the incoming diff list does not reference that ship, tests/test_gas_archive.js includes a passing regression scenario for unrelated schedule edits alongside pending UNFINISHED_SHIP, and node --test tests/test_gas_conditions.js tests/test_gas_triggers.js tests/test_gas_archive.js passes after the edit.
